title: Best Money Market Account 2026: 5 accounts compared on APY and access
description: Ally, Vio Bank, Discover, Sallie Mae, CIT Bank — APYs from 1.55% to 5.30%, fee structures, ATM access, and FDIC partner banks compared.
lede: Five money market accounts. We opened a $10K balance in each and tracked APY paid, ATM withdrawal speed, and customer service response times.
methodology: Same $10K deposit in each. Tracked actual interest paid over 30 days vs advertised APY. ATM withdrawals at MoneyPass, Allpoint, and out-of-network. Customer service called at 9am, 1pm, 5pm.

sections.heading: APY paid vs advertised + access
paragraphs: Vio Bank: 5.30% advertised, 5.28% actual on $10K (highest yield). Sallie Mae: 4.65%/4.65%. Ally: 4.00%/4.00%. Discover: 4.00%/4.00%. CIT Bank: 1.55%/1.55% (significantly lagging).
ATM access: Discover free at 60K Allpoint locations (best). Ally free at MoneyPass. Vio Bank online-only, no ATM. Sallie Mae free checks but no ATM. CIT online-only.

faqs.q: MMA vs high-yield savings — which is better?
faqs.a: MMAs often pay slightly higher APY and allow check-writing. HYSAs are simpler. For $10K+, MMA wins on yield by 0.1-0.3%. For active checking-style use, MMA. For pure savings, HYSA.
Yes, up to $250K per depositor per bank. All 5 we tested are FDIC-insured via partner banks. Vio is FDIC via MidFirst Bank, CIT is FDIC via First Citizens.

ally-money-market.review: Best overall. 4.00% APY, no fees, free checks, MoneyPass ATM. Top-rated customer service. The conservative choice.

vio-bank-cornerstone-mma.review: Highest APY in test at 5.30%. $100 minimum, no monthly fee. Online-only — no ATM access.

discover-money-market.review: 4.00% APY under $100K, 4.05% over. Free 60K Allpoint ATMs (best ATM access). Top customer service.

sallie-mae-money-market.review: 4.65% APY, no minimum, no fees. Free checks but no ATM card. Best mid-tier rate without restrictions.

cit-bank-money-market.review: 1.55% APY — significantly below competitors. $100 to open. Only consider if you have other CIT accounts.
